english: Set a meter's starting reading, or correct a reading that was already billed. Changes that could raise or hide a charge wait for a second person.
kinyarwanda: Shyiraho igipimo cyo gutangiriraho cya mubazi, cyangwa ukosore igipimo cyamaze gukorerwa fagitire. Impinduka zishobora kongera cyangwa guhisha amafaranga zitegereza undi muntu wa kabiri.

english: Use this for a replaced meter, or when WASAC's record is wrong. The next bill is measured from this value, so a wrong number can hide water that was used. A different supervisor or admin must approve it, unless the meter has no starting value yet.
kinyarwanda: Koresha ibi iyo mubazi yasimbujwe, cyangwa inyandiko ya WASAC itari yo. Fagitire ikurikira ibarwa uhereye kuri iki gipimo, bityo umubare utari wo ushobora guhisha amazi yakoreshejwe. Undi muyobozi agomba kubyemeza, keretse mubazi nta gipimo cyo gutangiriraho ifite.

english: Waiting for a second person to approve {reading} on {meter}.
You asked for this, so someone else must decide.
kinyarwanda: Ni wowe wabisabye, bityo undi muntu agomba gufata icyemezo.

english: Asked to set a starting reading
Photo clearly matches the digits, even if use is high: accept. It may be a real leak or real use.
kinyarwanda: Ifoto ihuye neza n'imibare, n'iyo amazi yakoreshejwe ari menshi: emeza. Bishobora kuba amazi yamenetse cyangwa yakoreshejwe koko.

english: Blurry photo: reject and ask for a new one.
Serial number or place does not fit: reject, it may be the wrong meter.
kinyarwanda: Nomero cyangwa ahantu ntibihuye: yange, ishobora kuba atari yo mubazi.

english: It keeps happening, or there is no photo and it is still unclear: send someone to the meter.
kinyarwanda: Bikomeza kubaho, cyangwa nta foto ihari kandi bitarasobanuka: ohereza umuntu kuri mubazi.

english: Upload a CSV with transaction_id, amount and reference. This stands in for WASAC's real records. Once a list exists, a payment can only be confirmed if its ID is on the list with the same amount.
kinyarwanda: Shyiraho CSV irimo transaction_id, amount na reference. Ibi bisimbura inyandiko nyazo za WASAC. Urutonde rumaze kubaho, ubwishyu bwemezwa gusa iyo nomero yabwo iri ku rutonde n'amafaranga angana.

english: The file needs transaction_id and amount columns.
kinyarwanda: Dosiye igomba kugira inkingi transaction_id na amount.

english: Not on the list: cannot be confirmed
Different amount on the list: cannot be confirmed
Paying at a bank? Use your meter number as the reference, then enter the bank's transaction ID below.
kinyarwanda: Urishyurira kuri banki? Koresha nomero ya mubazi yawe nk'indanganturo, hanyuma wandike nomero y'igikorwa ya banki hepfo.
